description: Backlog configuration file mapping Epics, Features, and Stories with their respective acceptance criteria and dependency orders.

epics.name: Auth, Security & Portal Shell
epics.description: Scaffold workspaces, authentication gates, idle session handling, and layouts.

features.name: Authentication & MFA Gate
features.description: Credentials login with secondary verification challenge.

stories.title: Advisor Login Form
acceptanceCriteria: Display email/password form with client-side field validation.
Submitting valid format credentials displays inline MFA challenge screen.

stories.title: MFA Challenge Code Verification
acceptanceCriteria: Display 6-digit numeric verification code input field.
Mock Validation: Accept code starting with '12' as valid; throw error on others.
Successful submission resolves session access and refresh tokens.

features.name: Session Management & Silent Refresh
features.description: Silent JWT rotations and session idle timeout timers.

stories.title: Silent Token Refresh Interceptor
acceptanceCriteria: Trigger silent refresh API calls 1 minute before access token expiry.
Failure of silent refresh automatically redirects user to login with notice.

stories.title: Session Inactivity Timeout
acceptanceCriteria: Track user input (mouse moves, keypresses) to calculate 14-minute idle timeout.
Show overlay modal warning with 60-second countdown.
Log out and clear memory cache if countdown reaches zero.

features.name: Advisor Shell & Layouts
features.description: Core responsive page layouts and navigation components.

stories.title: Authenticated Layout Routing
acceptanceCriteria: Provide sidebar navigation matching user role permissions.
Layout displays responsive navigation drawer on mobile and tablet screens.

stories.title: Household Context Header Bar
acceptanceCriteria: Provide dynamic pinned top header bar displaying active client name, AUM, and risk index.
Header syncs instantaneously when active client changes in Zustand store.

epics.name: Book of Business & Client Search
epics.description: Manage advisor clients directory, type-ahead search, and segment filtering.

features.name: Client Search Bar
features.description: Type-ahead client search bar with debouncing.

stories.title: Debounced Search Input
acceptanceCriteria: Debounce search requests by 200ms before sending query commands.
Allows searching by client name, account number, or masked Tax ID.

stories.title: Keyboard Navigation Results list
acceptanceCriteria: Supports pressing Down/Up arrows to navigate search results drop menu.
Pressing Enter loads highlighted client household dashboard.

stories.title: Segment and Due-Review Filters
acceptanceCriteria: Provide checkboxes to filter list by HNW ($1M-$10M), UHNW ($10M+), and review-due markers.
Allows multi-select options, sorting results by AUM descending by default.

epics.name: Holdings Grid & Market Ticker
epics.description: High performance data grids and real-time streaming tickers.

features.name: Virtualized Holdings Grid
features.description: Windowed rendering for high density position lists.

stories.title: Grid View Virtualization
acceptanceCriteria: Maintain 60fps scrolling on tables holding 10,000+ mock security entries.
DOM mounts only visible rows, absolute-positioning viewport slices.

stories.title: Column Configurations & Pinning
acceptanceCriteria: Allow dragging headers to resize and reorder column positions.
Supports pinning specific columns left or right, saving settings to LocalStorage.

stories.title: Grouping and Subtotal Rollups
acceptanceCriteria: Allow grouping positions by asset class (Equities, Cash, Alternatives).
Displays collapsable sub-headers calculating weight and market value sums.

features.name: WebSocket Market Data Streaming
features.description: Real-time quote streaming and rendering performance throttling.

stories.title: WebSocket Connection Status
acceptanceCriteria: Provide indicator badges: Live (Green), Delayed (Amber), and Offline (Red).
Displays banner notifying client on WebSocket drops, fallback to REST polling.

stories.title: Tick Coalescing & Flashing Cells
acceptanceCriteria: Throttles incoming event loops to 500ms intervals before pushing updates to Zustand.
Updates animate with localized green/red flashing effects fading out after 800ms.

epics.name: Portfolio Analytics & Rebalancing Sandbox
epics.description: Asset allocation wheels, model target comparisons, and staging what-if sandbox.

stories.title: Asset Class SVG Wheels
acceptanceCriteria: Render SVG allocation wheels responsive to layout resize parameters.
Hovering sections displays tooltips with segment weights and market values.

features.name: Model Drift Engine
features.description: Analyzing variance against model targeted guidelines.

stories.title: Drift Variance Calculations
acceptanceCriteria: Compare current holdings asset weights against target portfolio models.
Display drift values; trigger 'Rebalance' proposals to bridge gaps.

stories.title: Trade Staging Grids
acceptanceCriteria: Enable staging buy/sell transactions in a local Zustand store.
Simulated transaction list displays fees, cash impacts, and capital gains tags.

stories.title: Sandbox Comparison Panels
acceptanceCriteria: Allow naming, saving, and comparing multiple what-if layout configurations side-by-side.

epics.name: Compliance Gating & Reports
epics.description: Trade screening validations, Reg BI overrides, and PDF proposal compiling.

features.name: Pre-Trade Compliance Checks
features.description: Suitability checks and restricted lists validation.

stories.title: Staged Trade Validator
acceptanceCriteria: Analyze sandbox orders against concentration (no security > 10%) and risk profiles.
Displays inline warnings (Amber) or restricted lists blocks (Red).

stories.title: Reg BI Justification Overrides
acceptanceCriteria: Block proposal creation if Amber concentration warning is present.
Bypass block once advisor enters a minimum of 50 characters of rationale notes.

features.name: Proposal Document Generation
features.description: Branded PDF creation and version logs.

stories.title: Client Ready PDF Exports
acceptanceCriteria: Generates print-ready client reports with charts, fee listings, and disclaimers.
Applies clean print styles; formats breaks cleanly.

features.name: Compliance Review Dashboard
features.description: Review tools for Compliance Officer role.

stories.title: Proposal Audit Review
acceptanceCriteria: Display pending proposals queue showing flags and justifications.
Enable buttons to Approve/Reject proposals, outputting events to audit log.

epics.name: Goals & KYC Onboarding Wizard
epics.description: Goals funding trackers, resumable KYC steppers, and document uploading.

stories.title: Goals Progress Wheels
acceptanceCriteria: Display goal status cards showing funding progress bars.
Visualizes Monte Carlo success: On Track (>80%), At Risk (50%-80%), Off Track (<50%).

features.name: Resumable KYC stepper Wizard
features.description: Onboarding forms stepper with draft backup.

stories.title: Step Validation & Save
acceptanceCriteria: Validates input data before step changes.
Saves in-progress draft to IndexDB on each step transition.

stories.title: Draft Recovery Alerts
acceptanceCriteria: Prompt advisors to restore unsaved drafts if wizard closed prematurely.
Loads previous data, setting active view to last validated step.

stories.title: Size and Type Filters
acceptanceCriteria: Restrict file formats to PDF, PNG, and JPG; reject executables.
Limit file size to 10MB maximum, showing detailed error dialogs on limits.

epics.name: Cross-Cutting Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs)
epics.description: Accessibility audits, PII masking systems, offline support, and locale configurations.

stories.title: Tax ID Mask Timer
acceptanceCriteria: Mask tax strings as default value (***-**-1234).
Reveal requires clicking show button; logs event to audit log.
Auto-masks display after 30 seconds of inactivity or focus loss.

features.name: Offline Support & Sync
features.description: Offline connectivity notifications and sync resolution.

stories.title: Offline Write Gating
acceptanceCriteria: Display header notification on offline status.
Disable all transaction submissions and API updates, displaying cached databases.

stories.title: Locale Aware Formatting
acceptanceCriteria: Source all text headers and labels from locales JSON files.
Adjust dates, currency separators, and percentage scales dynamically by active language.
